audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows read 'Skill' in both layers, and the packet flags the chart outright: Urgot wins 54.5% over 923 games while the chart hands Irelia five stages to one.
audit.why: The mirror settles the shape: level 1 and levels 4-5 to Urgot, level 6 to Irelia because Vanguard's Edge walls off Disdain, and 2+ items back to Urgot; levels 2, 3 and first item stay hers, which is where the packet chart and the content whys already agree. Proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings and every contradicting why rewritten.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Urgot / Irelia / Irelia / Urgot / Irelia / Irelia / Urgot.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns on any of her tools, and Vanguard's Edge is never treated as the spike that decides level 6.
audit.why: Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s at 850, Bladesurge 10/9/8/7/6s at 600 and refreshes on a Marked or dying target, Defiant Dance 20/18/16/14/12s, Vanguard's Edge 125/105/85s at 950 and leaves a wall. Yours: Disdain 16s at rank 1 down to 14s, Purge 12/9/6/3/0s inside 490, Fear Beyond Death 100/85/70s. Her wall is what makes level 6 hers — it is the thing Disdain cannot charge through.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into the cooldown block, the do-line and the level-6 and first-item whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions that decide the fight are absent: Defiant Dance reduces physical damage while she charges it, Bladesurge's cooldown refreshes on a Marked target, and Disdain shields you as it charges.
audit.why: Purge is physical damage, so spraying into a charging Defiant Dance is the single most common way this trade is lost — the spray has to come after her swing. The refresh rule is why the stun landing first turns one dash into a chain. And Disdain's shield is the reason the flip is both your engage and your survival, which the mirror also added on its side.
audit.corrected: report[5].t states the damage reduction, breakdown.cooldowns the refresh condition, dontsFull[0].d the shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: The itemization line says Executioner's Calling 'cuts his healing' about Irelia.
audit.why: Bladesurge heals her on every strike, so the anti-heal purchase is right — only the pronoun is wrong.

edits.after: E or W second by kill pressure, but Bladesurge refreshes on a Marked or dying target — she is gone before Purge finishes.

notes: Chart taken from the mirror's key points (level 1 and levels 4-5 to Urgot, level 6 to Irelia for the Vanguard's Edge wall, 2+ items to Urgot) rather than from this packet's chart, which reads Skill at level 1 and Irelia at levels 4-5. The packet's own defect line agrees the old chart was wrong. Kit-flag misfire: Urgot's Corrosive Charge (Q) is tagged 'dash' but Riot's text gives it no movement. Not asserted: whether Vanguard's Edge's wall stops Disdain's charge specifically — the kit says it damages and slows enemies who walk through it, and the mirror's stronger claim was echoed only as 'bait it before you charge'.
